steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the freezer before resistance checks or harness service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Continue in test mode
steps.body: Test mode entered (§9.7). Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After test mode entry, proceed with OEM maintenance steps.

steps.title: Access evaporator fan
steps.body: Remove freezer air duct per §7.5. Verify DC 12 V fan motor (2020 r/min spec) is seated on shaft.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove freezer air duct per §7.5. Verify DC 12 V fan motor (2020 r/min spec) is seated on shaft.

steps.title: Forced cooling test
steps.body: Enter test mode (LOCK + − 3 s). Press + for forced cooling (display 1) — compressor and fan should run.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter test mode (LOCK + − 3 s). Press + for forced cooling (display 1) — compressor and fan should run.

steps.title: Fan runs in forced cooling
steps.body: With forced cooling active, does freezer fan rotate and move air?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With forced cooling active, does freezer fan rotate and move air?

steps.title: Replace evaporator fan
steps.oemOutcome: Replace DC 12 V freezer fan motor.

steps.title: Evaporator fan OK
steps.oemOutcome: Fan runs in forced cooling mode.
